run_mujoco_rerun_viewer: run the MuJoCo XML Rerun viewer CLI to visualize a scene XML and trajectory NPZ file
build_and_log_scene: build a Rerun scene graph from a MuJoCo MJCF XML file and log static geometry
export_scene_to_npz: export a MuJoCo scene's static geometry and local transforms to an NPZ file for offline use
play_trajectory: play a MuJoCo trajectory from an NPZ file by logging per-body world transforms to Rerun
log_scene_from_npz: load a pre-baked scene NPZ file and log its geometry to a Rerun visualization session
